Home More… BROKEN ARROW v2 – MIDI Overdrive & Boost Pedal – Jackson Audio Get link Facebook X Pinterest Email Other Apps January 10, 2026 The BROKEN ARROW v2 represents a modern, modular approach to overdrive design, combining multiple gain structures, studio-grade EQ, and MIDI control into a single, performance-focused platform. Built for players who require flexibility without compromising tone, it merges classic overdrive behaviour with contemporary switching and preset recall. At its core, the BROKEN ARROW is a soft-clipping overdrive inspired by traditional TS-style circuits, but without a fixed mid-hump. Instead, it relies on an active 3-band EQ to shape the signal precisely. Four selectable clipping diode presets, level-matched internally, allow meaningful tonal changes without volume jumps. The unique GAIN CYCLE feature enables stepped gain increases on the fly, making dynamic live transitions possible without touching the controls. Complementing the drive section is an independent MOSFET boost circuit, derived from the PRISM Preamp. With four boost voicings and true bypass operation, it can be used either to push the overdrive or as a standalone clean boost. Full MIDI implementation allows remote control of drive, boost, clipping modes, gain stages, and boost EQ, making the pedal suitable for advanced pedalboards and MIDI-based rigs. Key features: • Comprehensive overdrive and boost platform • Four clipping diode presets with level matching • Innovative GAIN CYCLE for stepped gain control • Independent MOSFET boost circuit with four voicings • Studio-grade 3-band active EQ (Baxandall-based) • Full MIDI control via TRS connection • True bypass boost loop • Designed for live performance and studio use Controls: • Volume (master output) • Gain (maximum gain reference) • Bass / Mid / Treble (±12 dB active EQ) • Boost level MIDI functions (via Control Change): • Drive on/off • Boost on/off • Clipping diode selection • Gain Cycle stage selection • Boost EQ preset selection Technical specifications: Input impedance: 1 MΩ Output impedance: 100 kΩ Power: 9V DC (centre negative) Current draw: 150 mA (minimum) Dimensions: 2.7” × 4.875” Product link: https://jackson.audio/products/brokenarrow?ref=sagpro (affiliate link) Image credits: Jackson Audio Affiliate disclosure: This post may contain affiliate links. Free Shipping Jackson Audio Broken Arrow v2 - MIDI quantity Add to cart SKU: BROKENARROW Category: Pedals Effects Tag: Jackson Audio Guaranteed Safe Checkout Description The Broken Arrow is a comprehensive overdrive platform that is designed to give guitarists an incredible range of overdriven tones with innovative features never before seen in ANY overdrive pedal ever made! The Broken Arrow is a very flexible overdrive with 4 presets for clipping options, an innovative gain adjustment feature that we call GAIN CYCLE, and a 3 band active EQ for maximum tonal flexibility. Boost Overview The boost circuit is in its own true bypass loop which means it can be used independently of the DRIVE circuit. The boost circuit in the BROKEN ARROW is a MOSFET based boost much like the AMP MODE found in our best selling PRISM Preamp pedal. To activate/deactivate the boost circuit simply press the BOOST footswitch. One of the things that makes the boost in the BROKEN ARROW different from other boosts on the market is that it has 4 presets available. Each preset is EQ’d slightly differently to allow it to alter how it interacts with the overdrive circuit in the BROKEN ARROW or any other pedal you may have in your rig Preset 1 – YELLOW LED: Bright Boost. Very useful for creating a thinner sound or when boosting a thick sounding overdrive. Preset 2 – GREEN LED: Mid Boost. Not as thin as the yellow mode, the green mode allows more lows and takes on the character of a mid boost. Preset 3 – AQUA LED: Tailored Boost. Most people will find this a perfect setting that will complement most any overdrive setting in the BROKEN ARROW. Preset 4 – BLUE LED: Full Range. No tonal coloring here! Just your guitars natural tone! To select a boost preset, press and hold the BOOST footswitch for more than 1 second and boost program mode will become active. When in this mode, the BOOST led will flash to indicate that you are in program mode. A quick tap on the BOOST footswitch will cycle the boost presets and you’ll be able to hear these presets change as you cycle through them, assuming that the boost circuit was active when the boost program mode was entered. Once you arrive at a boost preset that you want to use, press and hold the BOOST footswitch for more than 1 second and boost program mode will exit. Related products Sale! Sale!
